title: Gluing a connection correctly
promptMarkdown:
Let $
abla^{(i)}$ be connections on $E|_{U_i}$ and $(ho_i)$ a subordinate smooth locally finite partition. Prove $
abla=\sum_iho_i
abla^{(i)}$ is a connection. Show that the difference of two connections is $C^\infty(M)$-linear in both the vector field and section. In a line-bundle frame changed by $e'=g e$, derive the change in the connection one-form.
hintLadder: Write out the product rule before summing.
Differentiate $ge$, then express the answer in the new frame.
